bestBets.overview: This is it folks, Murwillumbah Cup day. Kick the eight race card off with 1550m Maiden where local hero Matthew Dunn saddles up six of the ten. That scenario always cools my jets from a punting point of view. Not so easy to bank on the map etc. No's 1,3,4,7,9 could be settling front half. Time shall tell. There's some very costly customers among his sextet as well. SORRENTI three times beaten as an odds-on fav. #Ouch. OCCUPATION started in the red when 3rd home latest. DIDIE'S MEADOW was downed at 'fours on' one day at Lismore. Did I say hero?  My goodness these facts read bad. Could be a few on a float to Central Qld any day now? Settled upon LATIN LIGHTS beaten a whisker Tuesday, the old quick back-up, maps well. Keeping out just the same.

raceTips.comment: Occupation hit the lead in the straight last time and stuck on soundly for the minor money. Hard-fit now and with Aaron Bullock sticking on can see him justify favourtism. Didie's Meadow strips fitter third up and has scope to improve over this longer trip. Grafting pulled up lame post race when resuming so best to be forgiving. Sharp improvement wouldn'y surprise. So Sain next.

bestBets.overview: 2020m Open Hcp. Maps say no's 4 and 8 make the pace. BARAZIN and AMPLIFY would appear to have a bit on these, back in the day the others would be weighted on 48 kg's and the likes of Peter Bakos would be doing the steering. BARAZIN has won lumping as much as 61 kg's, was found out under 62.5 at Gatton just three starts ago. AMPLIFIED has carried 57 to victory, and that was at Randwick, placed under 58.5 at Eagle Farm last start. Neither have raced at this track. I'm with the latter.

raceTips.comment: Amplify strikes a very nice race to get back into the winners circle and that is reflective in the market. She won't want it any wetter than what it is, but the stable makes smart use of a claimer and the extra furlong only aids her chances. Barazin has a good record over this distance range and looks the only genuine danger despite lumping weight. Last start winner Lord Protector looks the best hope at odds. Our Turn Now is hard-fit and maps to receive every chance.

bestBets.overview: 1550m C2. Was five potential pacemakers, now just one - number 2. THINK LIKE PADDY drops in class and is having his first start at home despite having been based here for at least 15 months. Placed at Eagle Farm on a Saturday just two starts ago. All that remains to be seen is whether or not 63 is within his scope. Ran well for 2nd under 61 just three starts ago. Distance suits CAPTAIN EAGLE, he also maps to get his chance. REDCLOUD is racing well, if they can run on this should. The filly VANAZADEE looks very suitably placed, traffic could well be all that's between chocolates and boiled lollies. For mine The Butler can do it.

raceTips.comment: Think Like Paddy drops in class but in turn has to carry big weight. Nonetheless, he gets the conditions to suits under hoof and only needs to run up to his efforts two and three back to go close. Captain Eagle backs up quickly and sets up to lead so should get every chance. Vanzadee might need a gap to appear at the right time but this race is certainly within reach. Escape Beach races well here and sets up as the map horse of the race.

bestBets.overview: 1200m Sprint. No's 4,5,6 bring the speed. OAKFIELD DUKE won well latest, is only 4th run in today, the issue is the rise from 58 to 62 kg's in one fell swoop. He's accustomed to carrying big weights, placed 2nd under 61 six starts ago but 62 is unchartered waters.  The grey is also having first start around here. Conversely THE WOLF is one for one here, winning this very event last year. Maps suitably, the worry is lead in form at the time was far more convincing then than is the case now. LADY WARDELL strips fitter for two from a spell, maps well as well. Win and place from two starts on this track. 4 claimer Siabh Kalani is two from just 15 career starts. The horse is weighted to be winning. Market watch on the stablemate LOVEWILLCOMELATER, resumed in Brisbane six weeks ago, since won a trial on a H10.

raceTips.comment: The Wolf appeals at the price. Comes off a freshen and the low draw should ensure he won't get posted wide like his past two starts. Can ping straight to the front and take running down. Oakfield Duke has to carry weight on the back of a last start win but that scenario isn't foreign to him. Aaron Bullock has a very strong strike rate aboard him and he should get a soft run throughout. Lady Wardell can improve third up over this longer trip. The best efforts from Krakarib are certainly good enough.

bestBets.overview: 1100m BM58. As things stand Dunn is good for three, that may become four. Peter Sinclair is good for two as is John Shelton. One has no choice but to pay attention to the fluc's from the moment the bookies dare stick up a set. No's 2,8,10,11  would appear to be the pace. Time shall tell. HAYLEY'S ROCKET won well at home base Grafton, that was five weeks ago, since trialed 3rd, first time to Murwillumbah, a polar opposite track. GOT THE SMARTS not the easiest to follow, but is a chance on best.   DEVIOUS WIND did it well at home aka Casino, maps a treat for Raymond Spokes to make it two for two from him for this 7yo. The resuming (unbeaten) WHY WAIT has had two trials to prep for just her 2nd start, winning and placing 2nd respectively. She landed good bets on debut, the lightly raced runner-up has ability. Jake Bayliss can give her a peach on the pace here.

raceTips.comment: Referees made a good account of himself in his initial campaign and has trialled nicely leading into the prep. Claimer on is a plus, will be strong late after settling in the back half of the field. Why Wait is the local hope with the x-factor after having won and debut and being spelled. Has a stack of upside. Hayley's Rocket comes here off a freshen and last start win and will have fans. Alleze is ready to peak third up.

bestBets.overview: And here it is - The 2026 Murwillumbah Cup. Fourteen can run. 3,4,6,7,10,11,12,15 candidates to set the pace, some more so than others. Interestingly most draw double digit barriers. Sets up well for LOCH EAGLLE but 63 is quite the load (twice won under 59). ROCK EMPIRE couldn't have had less favours in transit when winning at Randwick 2nd-up. The grit to prevail admirable. The barriers can  see R Maloney with the upper hand early. Whatever beats this should be winning.  GOLDEN CROSS is in rare form at Eagle Farm. Will this circuit suit remains to be seen. KIPLINGS JOURNEY could be the big improver, Slow out and sat a mile off them when also friendless 2nd-up. On its day goes forward and has a crack. AWAYGOESTHEBUNNY could find the line if the aforementioned pace gets a wriggle on early.

raceTips.comment: Rock Empire has been subject to strong early market support and on the back of last starts tough win it's not hard to see why. Expecting him to justify the quote. Castillian is hard-fit and has a good record over this distance range. Should get a soft trail throughout. Golden Cross keeps on winning which is hard to knock. High Dandy has the early speed to cross and lead so should get every chance.

bestBets.overview: 1200m C1. Note just twelve can run. No's 2,3,11 look certain to settle up there. As things stand Dunn is good for three, Samantha McGuren two. As things stand four will be 1st-up from a spell, five just 2nd-up. Has all the feels of respect the betting or scarper. SUPER LUCK DRAGON is much traveled having competed in HK and Victoria. All it took was a dose of reality, sent to Allan Chau, off to Brisbane and good bets were landed. Lack of early pace may be its 'kryptonite'. TEELG had plenty of excuses at Doomben last start. Fingers crossed it jumps cleanly, if so the map is   to win for. TILL DUSK resumes, R Maloney 1st time = reads like a free tip and the map is good, could become great.

raceTips.comment: Till Dusk has trialled well for the new stable and maps for a soft on speed run. Looks the clear horse to beat and that is reflective in the market. Teelg had excuses last time out but from an ideal draw in an easier field he can sharply improve. Bellarata sparks interest now being locally trained and is expected to be prominent in the run. Super Luck Dragon next.
